name: Radiology
tag: RVUs/shift, nights, call, modality mix, remote work, partnership, contract stability.
questions: What are RVUs/shift and annual expectations?
Is partnership available and what is buy-in?

samples.name: Private Radiology Partnership Track
samples.cons: Night/weekend burden and hospital contract risk must be reviewed.

samples.name: Teleradiology Role
samples.pros: Remote flexibility and clear shift pay.

Compensation: Is pay salary, shift rate, RVU productivity, partnership draw, or hybrid?
How are nights, weekends, holidays, internal moonlighting, and extra shifts paid?
What is the expected RVU/shift and annual RVU target?
Are partnership distributions equal, productivity-based, or seniority-based?
Are sign-on, relocation, retention, or loan repayment available?
Clinical model: What is the modality and subspecialty mix?
What are expectations for mammo, IR, breast procedures, emergency reads, peds, or nuclear/PET?
How many sites and worklists are covered?
Are turnaround-time expectations realistic with staffing and worklist tools?
APP / RPA / RA supervision: Who signs procedure notes, handles complications, and owns liability?
Does supervision improve productivity or add uncompensated work?
Quality bonus: Are metrics tied to turnaround time, peer review, critical results, report addenda, patient satisfaction, or biopsy follow-up?
What is the maximum quality bonus and historical payout?
Can metrics reduce compensation or only add upside?
Lifestyle / schedule: How many nights, weekends, holidays, and call shifts are required?
Are shifts fixed, rotating, or variable?
Is internal moonlighting optional or expected?
Partnership / contract risk: What is the partnership timeline, buy-in, and distribution formula?
What happens if the hospital contract is lost?
Is malpractice occurrence or claims-made, and who pays tail?
Are productivity expectations or schedules changeable unilaterally?

Clinical Fit: Modality/subspecialty mix and RVUs/shift match training and stamina.
Compensation Upside: RVU, shift, night/weekend, moonlighting, and partnership distributions are clear.
Lifestyle Fit: Nights, weekends, call, remote work, and vacation are sustainable.
Risk Safety: Hospital contract loss, tail, noncompete, and productivity changes are addressed.
Strategic Fit: Partnership, subspecialty demand, remote options, and group reputation build value.
Collaborative Fit: Technologists, referring clinicians, admins, RPAs/RAs, and worklist support are strong.
